description: This file contains test cases for the Svelte project template in a Python-based project initialization framework. It uses pytest fixtures and test functions to verify project initialization, template variable substitution, configuration loading, and script execution.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Creates and cleans up a temporary directory used for testing output paths.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Sets up a mock template directory with configuration files and template files for testing.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Creates a sample ProjectConfig object used for testing project initialization.

methods.name: test_svelte_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies that the template's initialization info can be retrieved and contains expected configuration commands.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests the process of initializing a project and verifies the output directory structure and content replacements.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Checks that the post-processing script executes correctly and completes as expected.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Ensures that project configuration can be loaded correctly from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Validates that template variables in files are correctly replaced with project-specific values during project setup.
